### What is broken

Opening `/widgets/` shows page not found (404) instead of the widgets page; `/widgets` works.

### Why it is broken

The part that matches web addresses to pages compares them exactly, so the final slash in `/widgets/` prevents a match. Trying the address locally showed the failure, and ignoring the final slash made the page load.

### How to fix it

Remove the final slash before comparing addresses so both forms reach the widgets page. An existing ticket already covers this problem, so no new ticket was created and work continues there ([#42](https://github.com/example/widgets/issues/42)).
